instruction: The workshop call guide is ready for circulation. Remove the yellow review highlighting from every marked phrase without changing the wording or any other formatting.

states.value:
Community Workshop Reminder Call Guide
This sample call guide supports follow-up with residents who asked about community technology classes. Use it as a guide only. If you adapt it, review every bracketed note for your program. Visit the staff portal for the current enrollment checklist.
Program Team: Good morning, may I please speak with [participant name]?
If the person is not available: Thank whoever answered and ask for a better time to call.
If the person is available: Confirm that you have reached the correct person before continuing.
Program Team: This is [caller name] from Harborview Learning Center [program team]. I coordinate the Digital Basics workshop with [instructor name]. Is now a convenient time to speak for a few minutes?
If the person says “No” or “I’m busy”
Program Team: Of course. [Offer two callback windows. If the person sounds unsure, thank them and end the call.]
If the person says “Yes”
Program Team: Great. You recently asked about help with everyday computer skills at Harborview Learning Center [branch name]. The Digital Basics series covers secure passwords, email attachments, online forms, and video appointments. Would you like a short overview?
If the person says “No” or “Not right now”
Program Team: That is completely fine. We only wanted to follow up on your request from [date]. If you change your mind, the Harborview Learning Center information desk can explain future sessions. Thank you for your time.
If the person would like the overview
Program Team: The next Digital Basics series meets on four Tuesday afternoons. Each session is held in the second-floor laptop lab and lasts about ninety minutes. The group is limited to twelve participants so instructors can provide individual help.
Participants practise on centre computers and may bring a personal phone, tablet, or laptop for selected activities. The laptop lab has adjustable desks, large-print keyboards, headphones, and a screen reader station. No previous class experience is required, and every activity can be repeated at home.
The first meeting begins with a short skills survey, a review of shared-computer privacy, and time to check each participant’s device. Staff at Harborview Learning Center can arrange a loaner device when one is requested before [request deadline].
Registration includes all four sessions, printed practice sheets, and two optional drop-in clinics. The clinics take place in the same laptop lab and are intended for questions that come up between classes. Participants are welcome to bring a support person to the first session.
Program Team: Before I reserve a place, I need to confirm your preferred name, a telephone number, and whether you would like any accessibility support. You may skip any optional question and you can ask us to remove your registration at any time.
If the person is ready to register
Program Team: May I confirm the spelling of your name? [Record the response.] Which telephone number should we use for a weather closure or schedule change? [Record the response.]
Program Team: Would large-print materials, step-free access, hearing support, or another adjustment make the workshop easier to attend? [Record only what the person chooses to share and pass the request to the access coordinator.]
If the person needs time before registering
Program Team: I can email or post the class summary for you to review. The summary lists session dates, transport information, accessibility contacts, and what to bring. I will hold a provisional place until [hold date], after which the place returns to the waiting list.
If the person asks for an email copy
Program Team: What email address should I use? ____________________ Thank you. I will send the summary from workshops@harborview-learning.example. Please check your junk folder if it does not arrive by tomorrow afternoon.
Program Team: Do you have any questions about the schedule, the activities, or getting to Harborview Learning Center?
Answer the person’s questions using the current program notes. If you are unsure, record the question and offer a callback.
Program Team: Thank you for your time. We will send the information you requested and contact you again only if you asked us to. Have a good day.
